title: SFX -- world rest (goodnight lullaby, music-box)
_note: The rest/sleep jingle the heal op plays over a black screen at every rest point (inns, the apprentice's bed, hearths). A tender two-bar statement of the Vesper contour (G-C-D lift ... E-D-C settle) on a music-box bell over a pluck harp, a soft pad and a hearth bass; the plagal C-F-C turn is the 'goodnight'. C major, Tinderwick's key. ~3.9 s incl. ring-out. Render --tail 0.6 to .wav, then encode to .mp3 untrimmed (it plays over silence).
